summary.zh: 关联采购订单历史与 GR/IR 未清项，解释差异原因、账龄和责任方，并给出受控清理建议。
summary.en: Links PO history to open GR/IR balances, explains causes, aging and ownership, and proposes controlled cleanup actions.

zh: MR11 仅作为人工复核建议
缺少范围或凭证证据时保留数据缺口
en: MR11 is only a human-review recommendation
Missing scope or evidence remains a data gap

description.zh: 按公司代码与期间读取范围受控的 GR/IR 余额和关联 PO。
description.en: Loads scope-bound GR/IR balances and linked POs for a company and period.

purpose.zh: 统一 SAP 只读数据或 fixture
purpose.en: Unifies read-only SAP data or fixtures

purpose.zh: 人工核对 GR/IR 科目未清项
purpose.en: Human verification of GR/IR open items

description.zh: 关联收货、冲销、发票、贷项与采购订单状态。
description.en: Links receipts, reversals, invoices, credits and purchase-order status.

purpose.zh: 标准化 EKBE、RBKP/RSEG 和 FI 证据
purpose.en: Normalizes EKBE, RBKP/RSEG and FI evidence

purpose.zh: 人工查看 PO 历史和发票
purpose.en: Human review of PO history and invoices

description.zh: 识别已收货未发票、已发票未收货、数量/价格差异、退货或长期挂账。
description.en: Classifies receipt-without-invoice, invoice-without-receipt, quantity/price differences, returns or stale balances.

purpose.zh: 原因规则、净额与证据校验
purpose.en: Cause rules, netting and evidence validation

description.zh: 计算账龄并路由采购、仓库、AP 或供应商责任，给出补票、冲销、调整或 MR11 复核建议。
description.en: Calculates aging, routes ownership and suggests invoice, reversal, adjustment or MR11 review.

purpose.zh: 稳定责任归属和处理建议

description.zh: 生成可追踪 JSON 或 CSV，供月结 follow-up 使用。
description.en: Produces traceable JSON or CSV for month-end follow-up.

purpose.zh: 结构化异常和人工跟进清单
purpose.en: Structured exceptions and human follow-up list
